excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content:
<nashatyrev_a> Hey @etan_status !
I have a question on `/eth/v1/beacon/light_client/updates` API method: 
Did I get it right that just a single `LightClientUpdate` is returned per one period (256 epochs)? 
Is it up to server to choose which `LightClientUpdate` from the whole period to be returned?

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content:
<etan_status> That’s correct. The server decides that.

The rules how honest full nodes select the update to return are described here:
https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/altair/light-client/full-node.md

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <etan_status> in section create_light_client_update underneath the code segment

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content:
<etan_status> The is_better_update helper can be found here:
https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/altair/light-client/sync-protocol.md#is_better_update

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content: <nashatyrev_a> Thanks for the info! Makes sense 👍
